solution.solution.lua:
function range(from, to, step)
    step = step or 1
    local n = from - step
    return function()
        n = n + step
        if to ~= nil and ((step > 0 and n > to) or (step < 0 and n < to)) then return nil end
        return n
    end
end

function from_list(t)
    local i = 0
    return function()
        i = i + 1
        return t[i]
    end
end

function lmap(gen, fn)
    return function()
        local v = gen()
        if v == nil then return nil end
        return fn(v)
    end
end

function lfilter(gen, keep)
    return function()
        while true do
            local v = gen()
            if v == nil or keep(v) then return v end
        end
    end
end

function take(gen, n)
    local out = {}
    for i = 1, n do
        local v = gen()
        if v == nil then break end
        out[i] = v
    end
    return out
end

function collect(gen)
    local out = {}
    for v in gen do out[#out + 1] = v end
    return out
end

hints: Each helper returns a new closure that, when called, asks its source for one value and passes it on (or skips it); nothing happens until someone calls it (lesson 8.02).
A generator works directly in a generic `for`: `for v in gen do ... end` stops at the first `nil`.
unitTests:
test("ranges", function()
    check_eq(collect(range(1, 5)), { 1, 2, 3, 4, 5 })
    check_eq(collect(range(10, 1, -3)), { 10, 7, 4, 1 })
    check_eq(collect(range(3, 1)), {})
    check_eq(take(range(1), 4), { 1, 2, 3, 4 })
end)

test("map and filter on an endless source", function()
    local odd_squares = lmap(lfilter(range(1), function(n) return n % 2 == 1 end), function(n) return n * n end)
    check_eq(take(odd_squares, 5), { 1, 9, 25, 49, 81 })
end)

test("lists", function()
    check_eq(collect(lmap(from_list({ "a", "b" }), string.upper)), { "A", "B" })
    check_eq(take(from_list({ 1, 2 }), 5), { 1, 2 })
end)

test("lazy: no extra calls", function()
    local calls = 0
    local gen = function() calls = calls + 1; return calls end
    take(lmap(gen, function(x) return x * 2 end), 3)
    check_eq(calls, 3)
    take(gen, 0)
    check_eq(calls, 3)
end)
